name: Pulse
tagline: Social and professional network for doctors and medical students
role: Mobile app development by the Softwhere team for Practitionet

scenes.title: A feed tuned to medical interests
scenes.body: Posts, specialty news and page updates in an activity feed with likes, comments and sharing.

scenes.title: Connections and mentor matching
scenes.body: Accept requests, discover recommended peers and request mentorship from students further along.

scenes.title: Pages for schools and groups
scenes.body: Organizations share posts and events that members can add to their calendar in one tap.

scenes.title: Group chats and direct messages
scenes.body: Real-time messaging on Stream Chat, with push notifications through Firebase and Notifee.

scenes.title: Ava, an AI career advisor
scenes.body: Pick goals, answer a few questions and get a saved, personalized plan, plus stage-based career guides.
